comparators.note: whitespace and line-ending normalization only; nothing that could make two different files compare equal
a SHA, a branch name or a ref listing compares exactly
command output, normalized for whitespace and ordering only
a query result set, normalized for row ordering
status and body, normalized for whitespace and header ordering
the kernel re-evaluates the predicate the observation satisfied rather than comparing a volatile raw value; a log line that has since rotated would otherwise mismatch for the wrong reason
same reason: error_rate < 0.01 is checkable a minute later, the exact value is not
a changed hash is a MISMATCH and the version difference is recorded. This same comparator, applied to the intake's own locator, is the source-drift check

pixels are not comparable mechanically. The content cannot be checked, but the provenance can: the adapter call that produced it is confirmed to have happened, against that URL, in that state, at that time, from the call log
